시편-29-1.title: 시편 29장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-29-1.exegesis: 9. The special prayer for the people sustains this view. feed them-- as a shepherd ( Psa 23:1 , &c.).
시편-29-1.theologicalNote: 9. The special prayer for the people sustains this view. feed them-- as a shepherd ( Psa 23:1 , &c.).

시편-29-2.title: 시편 29장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-29-2.exegesis: PSALM 29 Psa 29:1-11 . Trust in God is encouraged by the celebration of His mighty power as illustrated in His dominion over the natural world, in some of its most terrible and wonderful exhibitions. 1. Give-- or, "ascribe" ( De 32:3 ). mighty-- or, "sons of the mighty" ( Psa 89:6 ). Heavenly beings, as angels.

시편-29-3.title: 시편 29장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-29-3.exegesis: 2. name-- as ( Psa 5:11 ; 8:1 ). beauty of holiness-- the loveliness of a spiritual worship, of which the perceptible beauty of the sanctuary worship was but a type.
시편-29-3.theologicalNote: 2. name-- as ( Psa 5:11 ; 8:1 ). beauty of holiness-- the loveliness of a spiritual worship, of which the perceptible beauty of the sanctuary worship was but a type.

시편-29-4.title: 시편 29장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-29-4.exegesis: 3. The voice of the Lord-- audible exhibition of His power in the tempest, of which thunder is a specimen, but not the uniform or sole example. the waters-- the clouds or vapors ( Psa 18:11 ; Jr 10:13 ).
시편-29-4.theologicalNote: 3. The voice of the Lord-- audible exhibition of His power in the tempest, of which thunder is a specimen, but not the uniform or sole example. the waters-- the clouds or vapors ( Psa 18:11 ; Jr 10:13 ).

시편-29-5.title: 시편 29장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-29-5.exegesis: 4. powerful ... majesty-- literally, "in power, in majesty."
시편-29-5.theologicalNote: 4. powerful ... majesty-- literally, "in power, in majesty."

시편-29-6.title: 시편 29장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-29-6.exegesis: 5-6. The tall and large cedars, especially of Lebanon, are shivered, utterly broken. The waving of the mountain forests before the wind is expressed by the figure of skipping or leaping.
시편-29-6.theologicalNote: 5-6. The tall and large cedars, especially of Lebanon, are shivered, utterly broken. The waving of the mountain forests before the wind is expressed by the figure of skipping or leaping.

시편-29-8.title: 시편 29장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-29-8.exegesis: 7. divideth-- literally, "hews off." The lightning, like flakes and splinters hewed from stone or wood, flies through the air.
시편-29-8.theologicalNote: 7. divideth-- literally, "hews off." The lightning, like flakes and splinters hewed from stone or wood, flies through the air.

시편-29-9.title: 시편 29장 9절 역사문법적 주해
시편-29-9.exegesis: 8. the wilderness-- especially Kadesh, south of Judea, is selected as another scene of this display of divine power, as a vast and desolate region impresses the mind, like mountains, with images of grandeur.
시편-29-9.theologicalNote: 8. the wilderness-- especially Kadesh, south of Judea, is selected as another scene of this display of divine power, as a vast and desolate region impresses the mind, like mountains, with images of grandeur.

시편-29-10.title: 시편 29장 10절 역사문법적 주해
시편-29-10.exegesis: 9. Terror-stricken animals and denuded forests close the illustration. In view of this scene of awful sublimity, God's worshippers respond to the call of Psa 29:2 , and speak or cry, "Glory!" By "temple," or "palace" (God's residence, Psa 5:7 ), may here be meant heaven, or the whole frame of nature, as the angels are called on for praise.

시편-29-11.title: 시편 29장 11절 역사문법적 주해
시편-29-11.exegesis: 10-11. Over this terrible raging of the elements God is enthroned, directing and restraining by sovereign power; and hence the comfort of His people. "This awful God is ours, our Father and our Love."
